verdict: Organic visibility holding but softening; paid pipeline not yet active.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, your only active channel was Google Business Profile, which delivered a combined 395 actions — directions, calls, and web clicks — over the last 28 days. O'Hare Precision Metals was the brightest spot, with GBP activity up 25% week over week; Forte and Advance Grinding both saw GBP actions fall roughly 42% in the most recent 7 days, and search clicks are declining across all three brands, with several zero-activity days recorded in early October. No paid advertising is running on any entity, meaning the entire lead pipeline rests on organic visibility alone. Site reindexing and outreach sequences are in motion with an end-of-October target, which should stabilize and begin rebuilding search presence heading into the next period.

watch_item.issue: Organic search visibility is declining across all brands, with search clicks down 30–39% week over week and multiple zero-traffic days recorded in the last three days of the period — with no paid channel active to absorb the gap.
watch_item.fix: Three-site reindexing is underway and email outreach sequences are being launched this month to rebuild pipeline from both search and direct contact; both are on track for end-of-October delivery.
